title: 第24章：回村
novel_title: 穿越两界，我在80年代当倒爷
content_zh:
“我听说一些大厂，单位会进行改革，将来会有大量的工人下岗自谋生路，而且……沿海发达的省份已经开始试点了。”

    其实马超在后世，也不是光是摆摊卖菜，他还打听了不少关于80年到后面40年所发生的事。

    这就好比上天给打开了一扇窗户，一扇能预知未来40年发展的窗户，如果马超不想知道这些事，他才是真的傻。

    而这场席卷全国范围内的下岗潮，便是其中之一。

    话落。

    大姑一张脸都吓白了，“小超，这是假的吧！一定是假的，这要是真的以后该怎么活。”

    李军张了张嘴，脑子里一片空白。

    大姑父就更直接了，烟屁股掉在地上都没注意，不是没注意，是他此刻脑子已经失去了思考的能力。

    他也不是不相信马超的话。

    是大姑父将马超的话信了八九分。

    马超看着脸色灰白的三人，“大姑，大姑父，其实也没什么好担心的，国家总不会让人真的饿死。”

    “真有你说的这么轻松就好了。”
content_en:
"I heard that some large factories and units will carry out reforms, and a large number of workers will be laid off to make a living on their own in the future, and... developed coastal provinces have already started pilot projects."

    In fact, in later generations, Ma Chao did not just set up a stall to sell vegetables. He also inquired a lot about what happened from 1980 to the next 40 years.

    This is like God opening a window, a window that can predict the development of the next 40 years. If Ma Chao doesn't want to know these things, he is really stupid.

    The wave of layoffs sweeping across the country is one of them.

    The words fell.

    The aunt's face turned pale with fright, "Xiao Chao, this is fake! It must be a fake. How will we live in the future if this is true?"

    Li Jun opened his mouth, but his mind went blank.

    The eldest uncle was even more direct. He didn't even notice when the butt of his cigarette fell to the ground. It wasn't because he didn't pay attention, it was because his brain had lost the ability to think at this moment.

    It's not that he didn't believe Ma Chao's words.

    It was my eldest uncle who believed Ma Chao's words eight to nine times.

    Ma Chao looked at the three people with gray faces and said, "Auntie, uncle, there is actually nothing to worry about. The country will never let people really starve to death."

    "I wish it was as easy as you said."
